gaps.sentence: Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.

gaps.sentence: You'd better ___ a taxi or you'll miss the plane.
gaps.explanation: had better takes the bare infinitive: you'd better take.

gaps.sentence: The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.

gaps.sentence: It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ about the delay — nothing will change.
I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
gaps.explanation: would rather + somebody + past simple: I'd rather you didn't smoke.
